The next 30 days should focus on repeatable demos, scripts and first prospects.
A clear positioning line anchors the entire presentation.
Yudaro helps growing businesses connect people, knowledge, data and daily operations through Private AI, Odoo ERP, automation, POS solutions and practical implementation support.

Use: “We improve how the business works.”

Launch standard: one story, one message, one offer ladder.
The customer problem is operational friction
Use plain business language before showing technology.

• Sales, inventory and purchasing live in different systems
• Managers depend on people asking the right person at the right time
• SOPs and procedures are hard to find when employees need them
• Reports exist, but owners do not get answers fast enough
• Every improvement becomes another manual spreadsheet
Yudaro answer: connect the business system, then make knowledge usable through Private AI.
Separate the offer into two commercial tracks
This prevents the $899 POS offer from being confused with ERP implementation.
A simple, concrete restaurant POS package to generate leads and immediate sales.
Higher-value professional services for Odoo, Private AI, integration and automation.
Core correction: $899 restaurant POS does not include actual ERP implementation for restaurant or retail.
Position it as an easy, practical restaurant POS sale — not an ERP project.

• Restaurant POS setup package
• Ordering / checkout workflow
• Receipt printer / cash drawer / card reader support as configured
• Menu and basic product setup within defined package scope
Important: ERP implementation, Odoo customization, accounting workflow, inventory automation and AI integration are quoted separately.
What the $899 promotion includes — and excludes
This slide protects sales, delivery and customer expectations.

• Restaurant POS station configuration
• Basic menu/product setup per defined package
• Checkout, receipt and payment workflow testing
• Short operator handoff/training

• Odoo ERP implementation
• Accounting/inventory/purchasing customization
• Private AI or AI/Odoo integration
• Retail ERP implementation
• Custom reports, automations or data migration
Sales rule: never say “ERP included” when presenting the $899 restaurant POS promotion.
Retail POS is a capability, not the $899 promotion
Show the capability; quote retail separately after discovery.

• Discovery by store type
• Hardware and barcode needs
• Inventory and replenishment requirements
• Integration need: none, light or full ERP
• Separate quote based on scope
Use retail POS to open the discussion, but do not attach it to the restaurant $899 price unless a separate retail bundle is approved.
The site explains the broader AI + ERP company behind the POS promotion.

Present Private AI as business memory, SOP search and management assistance.
Draft a follow-up to this customer.
Key message: the AI should answer from approved company knowledge, permissions and business context — not from generic guessing.
A differentiator: the company’s way of thinking becomes reusable.
approved knowledge + ERP context + role permissions
This is the concept that makes Yudaro more than software installation: the system learns how the company prefers to solve problems.
Show Odoo as the operating backbone, not a confusing module list.
Demo rule: use one realistic customer process from order to report. Do not wander through every Odoo menu.
AI + ERP: the high-value service story
POS sells the door-opener; AI + ERP sells the transformation.

• Show me last month’s sales by salesperson
• Which customers have not ordered in 60 days?
• Which inventory items are running low?
• Generate a purchasing recommendation for approval
Position this as a separate service package after discovery, implementation planning and data-access confirmation.
Wednesday demo should follow one customer story
A connected narrative is easier to understand than six disconnected demos.
Slow reporting, manual work, scattered knowledge
Practical POS solution, no ERP included
Natural-language insight from real business data
A polished backup beats a broken live demo.
Use a pre-tested account and sample data.
Every live step has a clean screenshot fallback.
Record key AI + ERP moment as backup.
Wednesday objective: confidence. Avoid anything that creates doubt about delivery discipline.
Revenue ladder after the POS promotion
The $899 offer should open the door to higher-value engagements when the need is real.
Do not overpromise the ladder. Move up only when the customer has real operational need and budget.
Target customers for the first sales wave
Start where pain is visible and demos are easy to understand.
POS pain, order workflow, owner reporting
inventory, purchasing, sales reports, delivery workflow
Early sales should prioritize prospects who can understand the demo within 15 minutes.
Sales talk track: diagnose before proposing
The first meeting should expose operational pain, not dump technology.
Where do orders, inventory and reports break down today?
What do managers ask you for that takes too long to answer?
Which employee knowledge is hard to transfer to new staff?
Which manual spreadsheet would you eliminate first?
If one report could appear every morning, what would it be?
Then offer the correct path: $899 restaurant POS, retail POS quote, ERP project, Private AI project, or AI + ERP integration.
The Wednesday decision should trigger a short, disciplined sales sprint.
POS scope, exclusions, one-page flyer, quote template
sample data, backup screenshots, owner script
restaurant list, retail list, first demos
objections, pricing adjustments, first case story
By day 30, Yudaro should know which message sells, which objections appear, and which package needs refinement.
Keep time tight and momentum high.

The first few customer conversations will define Yudaro’s credibility.
